relationships.claim: Renal homeostasis couples glomerular filtration with tubular reabsorption and secretion; urinary excretion is adjusted through these linked nephron processes.
Macula densa sensing of tubular sodium-chloride delivery participates in tubuloglomerular feedback that helps regulate glomerular filtration and renal autoregulation.
Changes in proximal tubular sodium and glucose reabsorption can alter downstream salt delivery and thereby modify tubuloglomerular feedback and glomerular filtration dynamics.
